calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS first_period, 4 AS last_period
)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- stores only: no web, no training store
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- staff purchases are out of ATV
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'                  -- test articles out
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY atv DESC;

calls.statement:
-- My query total
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS first_period, 4 AS last_period
)
SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) AS my_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period;

-- Control total from rpt_daily_store_sales
WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) AS period_start, MAX(calendar_date) AS period_end
    FROM dim_date
    WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4
    GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
)
SELECT SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
CROSS JOIN date_range d
WHERE r.business_date >= d.period_start
  AND r.business_date <= d.period_end
  AND r.store_id < 900;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS first_period, 4 AS last_period
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS staff_net_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_net_sales,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_before_filters
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period;
